_readme: Proposed limits for real-money trading. Plain-English version: docs/trading-rules.md. Nothing trades unless approved=true AND mode='live'. Dollar amounts are USD.
_mode_options: paper = simulate only (today) | dry_run = build real orders, print them, send nothing | live = send orders

bankroll._reserve_note: kept back on each venue so a hedge or fee can always be paid

loss_limits._note: daily stop = no new trades until tomorrow; drawdown kill = cancel everything and stop until a person resets it

learning._note: the learner may only re-order which trades get capital first and skip kinds of trades that are confidently losing; it can never raise a limit or loosen a rule. Suggested rule changes go to `python scripts/learn.py` for you to approve

auto_kill_on: 3 API errors in a row on either venue
venue balance differs from the bot's books by more than $1
an unhedged leg older than max_unhedged_minutes that cannot be hedged within max_hedge_slippage_cents
a game we hold is postponed or cancelled
kill_switch.on_kill: cancel all open orders on both venues, keep existing hedged positions, notify via GitHub issue
